depth_m.note: Rock thickness above the SAGE (GGNT) low-background laboratory, 3.5 km from the entrance of the horizontal adit, as stated by the Baksan Neutrino Observatory's own 2016 presentation (4700 m.w.e. on the same slide; SAGE's 1999 paper gives the same 4700 m.w.e. and the 3.5 km). name: BNO — Baksan Neutrino Observatory
notes: This map is thin: the surface administrative building, the Neutrino settlement and the Main adit entrance are drawn from OpenStreetMap, but the tunnel path and the SAGE underground hall are not, because no source consulted gives the tunnel's path or bearing and OpenStreetMap does not appear to trace it (no way was found by a Nominatim name search for 'Baksan tunnel' or Cyrillic equivalents).

SAGE's own 1999 paper (src:sage-1999-capture-rate) states the laboratory is '3.5 km from the entrance of a horizontal adit excavated into the side of Mount Andyrchi' with a 60x10x12 m chamber (src:geo-euro-ug-pandola-2011). Drawing it would need a topographic source, or an OpenStreetMap trace of the tunnel, giving the tunnel's bearing.
The Main adit entrance is drawn from an OpenStreetMap node. The unlocated row cites the official INR distances (550 m to BUST, 3.5 km to SAGE) and halls; the tunnel path and halls are not drawn.

summary.plain: The Baksan Neutrino Observatory in the Russian Caucasus: the surface administrative building, the purpose-built village of Neutrino and the Main adit entrance are drawn to scale; the SAGE gallium detector, 3.5 kilometres inside the mountain, has a sourced distance but no sourced path to draw it by.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:baksan-neutrino-observatory. Only surface features (OSM: the BNO administrative building, way 1504181774; the Neutrino settlement, way 206835293; the Main adit entrance, node/4244310615) are drawn. site:baksan-sage-underground-lab is not drawn: SAGE's own 1999 paper gives its distance from the adit entrance (3.5 km) but not the tunnel's bearing, and no OpenStreetMap trace of the tunnel was found.

unlocated.backlog: A published bearing or plan of the Main adit (INR technical drawing, the 'longitudinal section of the underground complex' of the INR page Fig. 1 with a plan view, or a topographic map of the underground complex); with the bearing, the BUST hall (550 m) and the SAGE hall (3.5 km) are one line-offset each from the entrance node.
unlocated.reason: Official INR pages give the layout along the tunnel but not in plan: two parallel horizontal adits about 4 km long into Mount Andyrchi; the Baksan Underground Scintillation Telescope hall 550 m from the start of the horizontal tunnel (base 16.7 m x 16.7 m, ~850 m w.e.); the gallium-germanium telescope (SAGE) laboratory 3.5 km from the tunnel entrance, with a 60 m x 10 m x 12 m hall at 4700 m w.e. No fetched source gives the adit's bearing or a coordinate for any hall, and OpenStreetMap maps only the Main adit entrance (drawn), not its path.
